propositions: gen_env_registry.py::scan() recognises only os.environ.get, os.environ[...], and os.getenv(...), causing any other attribute access (pop, setdefault, __getitem__) to silently omit environment variable keys from the generated docs/env-vars.md registry

Changing an environment read from os.environ.get() to os.environ.pop() drops the variable from documentation without error or warning, violating the stated invariant that new env-var reads cannot ship undocumented
make lint does not run the generator's --check, so staleness appears only in the full test suite; local and CI verdicts diverge, violating the local-gate contract
os.environ attribute accesses that the scanner does not classify should raise UnrecognisedEnvironAccess with the offending path:line, not silently skip, to implement fail-closed detection
Two existing os.environ.pop() sites in the codebase are currently registered via sibling os.environ.get() reads, masking the defect latently
